description: Far Cry 2: Fortune's Edition + Realism Plus Redux (Ubisoft 2008, Dunia, via Proton)
long: Far Cry 2 is an open-world first-person shooter set in a war-torn African nation, where a mercenary suffering from malaria hunts an arms dealer known as the Jackal. It is known for its emergent systems, including spreading fire, weapon degradation and self-administered field medicine. This package is Fortune's Edition with the community Realism Plus Redux overhaul applied, run through Proton.
name: Far Cry 2: Fortune's Edition + Realism Plus Redux
